summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Southgate Smoke Shop Time Clock. 24/24 backend pytest tests passed covering auth, kiosk full clock cycle (with double-in / double-break / clock-out-on-break / end-non-existent-break rejections), late detection wiring, employee CRUD + duplicate/PIN validation, schedule CRUD, timecard edit with audit trail preservation (original + new + reason + changed_by_name + timestamp), reports/exports (CSV & PDF), payroll gating by supervisor_can_view_payroll setting, settings owner-only guard, history filters (late, missing_out), and RBAC (supervisor 403 on owner-only endpoints). Frontend Playwright smoke: kiosk verify + action flow works with data-testids, owner login redirects to /admin, all 5 stat tiles render, sidebar shows 10 nav items for owner, supervisor sidebar correctly hides Settings & Audit (only 8 nav items), Employees/Schedules/Timesheets/Reports/Settings/AuditLog pages load with expected controls (add-employee, sched cells, edit-timecard/add-timecard, export-csv/pdf, settings-save). Audit log page shows the 'TEST correction' entry created via API — end-to-end audit trail confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Stat tile data-testid uses underscore (stat-currently_working, stat-on_break, stat-not_clocked_in, stat-late, stat-total_hours) — spec example listed 'stat-*' generically; keep in mind for future selectors that dash-vs-underscore matches backend key names.

kiosk_action clock_in late calculation uses datetime.now(tz) for scheduled datetime but compares against ts.astimezone(tz); OK, but if a shift crosses midnight the same-day .replace() would be wrong (edge case, not currently required).
get_settings inserts a doc containing 'id':'store' but read strips _id; upsert in update_settings sets 'id' each time — fine but redundant.

CORS allow_origins uses split(',') on '*' which becomes ['*']; combined with allow_credentials=True this is technically invalid per CORS spec (browsers will reject credentialed requests from '*'). Not exercised here since Bearer token auth is used, but recommend explicit origins in production.
No rate-limit on kiosk endpoints — a bad actor could brute force PINs. Consider adding attempt tracking similar to login_attempts.
test_credentials: Owner owner/Owner@2025, Supervisor erostova/Super@2025, Kiosk EMP102/1234 — all valid.
seed_data_creation: Test created & deleted TEST_EMP999 employee, created a schedule for EMP102 today 09:00-17:00, and edited the first available timecard with reason 'TEST correction' which now exists in the audit log.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/ is idempotent and safe to re-run. It leaves an audit-log entry ('TEST correction') and adjusts settings.supervisor_can_view_payroll back to False after payroll tests. EMP102 will end in clocked_out state after the kiosk cycle test.
